title: Tuulada ku taal Xeebaha Maxkamadaynta
intro: Waxaad isku aragtaa tuulo xeeb ah, halkaas oo dhawaaqa hirarku uu isku dhex milmo oo ay ku jiraan codad dad la ilaaway ah. Waxaa la siiyay amar nasasho, laakiin hungurigoodu wuxuu horseeday ciqaab weli laga hadlo codad aamusan. Ma ogaan kartaa cidda ay ahaayeen?
clues: Waxaan ku noolayn xeebta agteeda waxaana naloo amray inaan ilaalino maalin nasasho ah.
Maalintaas, kalluunku wuu noo imaan jiray isagoo aad u badan, laakiin waa nalaga mamnuucay inaan qaadanno.
Qaar naga mid ah ayaa ka digay xadgudubka, laakiin kuwa kale si kastaba ha ahaatee waxay ku shirqooleen inay kalluumaystaan.
Waxaan jebinay amarka quduuska ah, waxaana na soo gaarnay ciqaab daran.
Ciqaabteennu waxay ahayd isbeddel naga dhigay mid fool xun oo ceeb ah.
Waxaa naloo rogay daanyeer, calaamad u ah dhammaan kuwa daba iman doona.
arabic: وَسْـَٔلْهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ ٱلْبَحْرِ إِذْ يَعْدُونَ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ إِذْ تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتَانُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًۭا وَيَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُونَ ۙ لَا تَأْتِيهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَبْلُوهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient. (7:163)
